questions.question: What number must be added to each of the numbers 7, 4 and 2 so that the resulting numbers may be in a continued proportion?
questions.solution:
**Given**

7,4 and 2 should be in a continued proportio**n**

**Concept**

Continued proportion means the ratio between the first and the second is equal to the ratio between the second and the third

**Calculation**

let x is added in each number

(7 + x)/(4 + x) = (4 + x)/(2 + x)

⇒ (7 + x) (2 + x) = (4 + x) (4 + x)

⇒ 14 + 7x + 2x + x² = 16 + 8x + x²

⇒ 14 + 9x + x² = 16 + 8x + x²

⇒ 14 + 9x = 16 + 8x

⇒ 9x - 8x = 16 - 14

⇒ x = 2

**∴ 2 must be added to each of the numbers 7, 4 and 2 so that the resulting numbers may be in a continued proportion.**

⇒ Second discount percentage = (12825 ÷ 106875) × 100

⇒ Second discount percentage = (1 ÷ 8.333...) × 100 = 12%

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two discounts d₁% and d₂% are given successively, the effective equivalent discount percentage is given by (d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100)%.

Marked Price & Selling Price

Ratio Method for Discounts

For multiple continuous discounts, the overall ratio of SP to MP is the direct product of the individual multiplying factors of each respective discount.

• National Emergency- Under Article 352, the president can declare a national emergency when the security of India or a part of it is threatened by war or external aggression, or armed rebellion.
 
• Constitutional Emergency- Under Article 356, empowers the President to issue a proclamation if he is satisfied that a situation has arisen in which the government of a state cannot be carried on in accordance with the provisions of the constitution.
 
• Financial Emergency- Article 360 empowers the president to proclaim a Financial Emergency if he is satisfied that a situation has arisen due to which the financial stability or credit of India or any part of its territory is threatened.

questions.question: Which of the following items does not directly affect the current account balance of India?
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is __**Revenue Income**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **current account balance** of payments is a record of a **country's international transactions with the rest of the world.**
 
• The current account includes all the transactions (other than those in financial items) that involve economic values and occur between resident and non-resident entities.
 
• **Revenue Income** - Government revenue or national revenue is money received by a government from taxes and non-tax sources to enable it to undertake government expenditures.
 
• **Net foreign income, foreign aid,** and** trade gap** are all concerned with a country's international transactions with the rest of the world.
 
• **Since the revenue income is not a country's international transaction, therefore, it does not directly affect the current account balance of India.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Trade gap **is a situation in which a country buys more from other countries than it sells to other countries. It is the amount of money by which a country's imports are greater than its exports.
 
• **Foreign aid** is the international transfer of capital, goods, or services from a country or international organization for the benefit of the recipient country or its population.

questions.question: Which of the following organizations was established earlier than the other three organizations during the British rule?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmo Samaj.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **The Brahmo Samaj** was formed in **1828.**

 
 
• It prohibited all forms of idolatry and sacrifice, believed in the Upanishads and forbade its members from criticising other religious practices.
 
 
 
• **The Prarthana Samaj **was founded in **1867 in Bombay by Dr Atmaram Pandurang.**
 
 
• It was an off-shoot of Brahmo Samaj.
 
• It was a reform movement within Hinduism and Justice M.G. Ranade and R.G. Bhandarkar joined it in **1870 **and infused new strength to it.
 
 
 
• **Paramahansa Mandali **was a secret socio-religious group,** established in 1849,** in Bombay and is closely related to Manav Dharma Sabha.
 
• **Satyashodhak Samaj **(Truth-seekers' Society) was a social reform society founded by Jyotirao Phule in Pune, Maharashtra, on** 24 September 1873.**
 
• **Hence Brahmo Samaj was established earlier than the other three organizations.**
